name: Binaural Nature
description: Nature music for headphones: places built from ambiences, creatures and weather, each using the two ears as part of the scene. Rain falling around your head, a brook that runs past you, crickets hopping from ear to ear, a sea cave whose hum opens from a point into the rock, a storm that crosses overhead, a campfire under turning stars, a dawn chorus placed all around, wind wandering through the pines, a whale circling beneath you and a tune hidden in a spring. Each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume low.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Rain Canopy
sketches.description: Headphones on: rain on the leaves above you, drops falling at random points around your head, a fine mist that differs in each ear and a 2 Hz delta drone under a soft D minor pad.

sketches.name: Brook Crossing
sketches.description: A brook runs past you from left to right, a wren sings on the far bank and a thrush behind you, while a pluck sways between your ears on delays under a millisecond, like stepping from stone to stone.

sketches.name: Night Meadow
sketches.description: Headphones on: crickets all around, close chirps hopping between your ears, frogs at a pond behind you and an owl far off, under slow choir chords and a 4 Hz binaural beat in the theta range. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.

sketches.name: Sea Cave
sketches.description: Inside a sea cave: waves heard through the rock, water dripping from the roof at points around you, a hum that steps from the centre of your head out into the stone, and bells of light from the entrance drifting apart in cents. On speakers the 180-degree bars of the hum nearly vanish.

sketches.name: Storm Overhead
sketches.description: Headphones on: eight bars of a storm that comes in from your left, passes right over your head and rolls away behind you. The rain swells and fades, and the gusts are wide and enveloping.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)

// Eight bars: the storm comes in from your left, passes overhead and rolls away behind you
rain: s("rain").intensity("<.25 .35 .55 .8 .8 .6 .4 .25>").gain(.28)

// Thunder moves bar by bar: around you, up overhead and closer, then away
thunder: s("<[~ lt] ~ [lt ~ ~ lt] lt [lt lt ~ lt] lt ~ [~ lt]>").speed(.5).lpf(300)
  .azimuth("<-120 -90 -45 0 30 90 140 170>").elevation("<10 20 45 70 70 45 20 10>")
  .distance("<9 7 4 2 2 4 7 9>").room(.9).size(.95).gain(.5)

// Gusts: unrelated noise in each ear, wide and enveloping, rising and falling with the storm
wind: s("pink").icorr(.15).hpf(200).lpf(sine.range(400, 2000).slow(8))
  .gain("<.03 .05 .08 .12 .12 .08 .05 .03>")

// A dark pad and a slow bass underneath: Em, C, Am, B
pad: note("<[e3,b3,d4] [e3,b3,d4] [c3,g3,b3] [c3,g3,b3] [a2,e3,c4] [a2,e3,c4] [b2,f#3,a3] [e3,b3,d4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2).lpf(sine.range(500, 1600).slow(8))
  .attack(.6).release(1.5).room(.6).gain(.14)
bass: note("<e2 e2 c2 c2 a1 a1 b1 e2>").s("sine").attack(.3).sustain(.8).release(1).gain(.3)

sketches.name: Campfire Stars
sketches.description: A fire in front of you, crickets in the dark, an owl behind and stars twinkling high above, while a drone's phase turns slowly between your ears and a guitar widens bar by bar. All rates stay below 3 Hz.
sketches.source:
setcpm(52/4)

// The fire in front of you, the woods all around
fire: s("fire").slow(4).intensity(.35).density(6).distance(1.5).gain(.24)
crickets: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(-100).distance(6).gain(.06)
owl: note("<[~ ~ d4 [d4 a3]] ~ ~ ~>").s("hum").azimuth(150).distance(7)
  .attack(.05).release(.5).gain(.14)

// irate turns the phase between the ears, in turns per second
// All rates stay below 3 Hz, so no pulse warning is needed
drone: note("[d2,a2]").s("sine").irate("<.25 .5 1 .5>")
  .attack(1).sustain(1).release(1).gain(.24)

// From about 1 to 30 ms the guitar stays on the leading side but grows wider each bar
guitar: note("<[d3 a3 d4 f4 a4 f4 d4 a3] [bb2 f3 bb3 d4 f4 d4 bb3 f3] [c3 g3 c4 e4 g4 e4 c4 g3] [a2 e3 a3 c#4 e4 c#4 a3 e3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.005).decay(.8).sustain(0).release(1)
  .itd("<1 6 12 6>").lpf(2200).room(.4).gain(.2)

// Stars twinkling high above, each in its own place
stars: n(irand(8).segment(8)).scale("D:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.8).seed("embers")
  .s("sine").decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.5)
  .azimuth(rand.range(-180, 180)).elevation(60).distance(4).room(.6).gain(.08)

sketches.name: Dawn Chorus
sketches.description: Headphones on: the dawn chorus placed all around you, with a lark rising and crossing high overhead, a morning flute and harp straight ahead, and a quiet 10 Hz binaural beat in the alpha range for waking gently. The player asks before playing, as with any steady pulse.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)

// The dawn chorus all around you: each bird has its own place
robin: s("bird").slow(2).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.26)
wren: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(60).elevation(25).distance(4).gain(.22)
blackbird: s("bird").slow(5).azimuth(150).distance(6).gain(.18)

// A lark crossing high overhead, gliding between positions
lark: s("bird").slow(4).azimuth(saw.range(-90, 90).slow(16)).elevation(50).distance(8).posglide(.5).gain(.16)

// A dove cooing behind you on the left
dove: note("<[~ e4 [e4 c4] ~] ~>").s("hum").azimuth(-120).distance(5)
  .attack(.05).release(.4).gain(.12)

// A 10 Hz binaural beat in the alpha range: keep it quiet
drone: note("<g2 g2 e2 c2>").slow(2).s("sine").binaural(10)
  .attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.16)

// A morning flute and a harp, straight ahead: G, Em, C, D
flute: note("<[g4@2 a4 b4 d5@3 b4] [e5@2 d5 b4 g4@4] [e4 g4 a4 b4 a4@2 g4 e4] [d4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.6).release(.5).delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.24)
harp: note("<[g3 b3 d4 b3] [e3 g3 b3 g3] [c4 e4 g4 e4] [d3 f#3 a3 f#3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Pine Wind
sketches.description: Wind through a pine forest: nothing is panned, yet the gusts wander between your ears, as each ear has its own low-pass sweeping the other way. Trunks creak around you, a woodpecker drums far off and a pad sends alternate partials to each ear, complete only when both ears hear it.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// Wind through the pines: each ear has its own low-pass, sweeping in opposite directions
// The level stays put; only the brightness of the gusts wanders between the ears
wind: s("pink*4").hpf(200).attack(.2).release(.4)
  .lcutoff(saw.range(500, 3000).slow(8)).rcutoff(isaw.range(500, 3000).slow(8)).gain(.06)

// Trunks creaking around you, a woodpecker far to the right, a jay behind
trunks: s("~ ~ creak ~").mask("<1 0 0 1 0 1 0 0>")
  .azimuth("<-60 80 -120 30 150 -30 90 -150>").distance(4).gain(.14)
woodpecker: s("rim*8 ~ ~ ~").mask("<0 1 0 0 0 0 1 0>").speed(2).lpf(3000)
  .azimuth(80).distance(7).gain(.16)
jay: s("bird").slow(6).azimuth(-140).elevation(30).distance(6).gain(.14)

// earsplit("harmonics") alternates the partials between the ears: each ear hears a thinner chord
pad: note("<[e3,b3,e4,g4] [c3,g3,c4,e4] [d3,a3,d4,f#4] [b2,f#3,b3,d4]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").earsplit("harmonics").lpf(1600)
  .attack(2).sustain(1).release(3).room(.6).gain(.12)

// A wooden flute, the same in both ears
flute: note("<[b4@3 a4] [g4@2 e4@2] [a4@3 f#4] [e4@4]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(4.5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.3).sustain(.6).release(1).room(.6).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Whale Song
sketches.description: Headphones on: beneath the waves, a whale circles slowly below you, gliding from note to note, while a calf answers from the other side, bubbles rise past your ears and a 2 Hz binaural drone hums in the deep.
sketches.source:
setcpm(44/4)

// The open sea far above you
surf: s("surf").slow(8).intensity(.3).elevation(50).distance(4).gain(.22)

// The deep: a 2 Hz binaural drone, below the 3-30 Hz warning range
deep: note("<d1 d1 bb0 c1>").slow(4).s("sine").binaural(2)
  .attack(4).sustain(1).release(6).gain(.28)

// A whale circling slowly beneath you once every sixteen bars, gliding from note to note
whale: note("<[d3@2 a3@4 g3@2] ~ [f3@3 c4@3 a3@2] ~>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .mono(1).glide(.4).vib(3).vibdepth(.2).attack(.6).sustain(.8).release(2)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(16)).elevation(-30).distance(8).posglide(1)
  .room(.8).gain(.2)

// A calf answers from the other side
calf: note("<~ [a4@3 d5@5] ~ [g4@4 c5@4]>").s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .mono(2).glide(.3).vib(4).vibdepth(.2).attack(.4).sustain(.6).release(1.5)
  .azimuth(120).elevation(-20).distance(10).room(.8).gain(.12)

// Bubbles rising past your ears
bubbles: s("drip*8?0.3").azimuth(rand.range(-180, 180)).elevation(rand.range(-40, 40))
  .distance(1.5).seed("bubbles").gain(.1)

sketches.name: Hidden Spring
sketches.description: A spring bubbling up in a clearing. The splashes are white noise, but between the ears they carry a faint tune (Huggins pitch); each ear alone hears only water. A quiet sine plays the first phrase every four bars so you know what to listen for. The effect is faint and differs between listeners.
